character: One of Japan's largest ski areas: about 18 interconnected areas on a high plateau in Joshinetsu Kogen National Park, reaching 2,307 m at Yokoteyama. Its altitude gives one of the longer seasons in Honshu, and Jigokudani's snow monkeys are nearby.
learning: Reference, confirm: with many separate areas there are plenty of gentle slopes and several ski schools; the Shiga Kogen tourism site has a guide to choosing a ticket.

transfers.name: Hokuriku Shinkansen to Nagano, then express bus to Shiga Kogen
transfers.notes: Usually reached by Hokuriku Shinkansen from Tokyo (or Ueno) to Nagano, about 1.5 h, then by bus. Reference, confirm 2026-27 timetables and fares. Express buses from Nagano station to Shiga Kogen take roughly 70 min; alternatively take the Nagano Electric Railway to Yudanaka, then a bus.
